notes.title: Key Config. Function Implemented in Today's Patch
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your patience.

We''ve implemented the key config. function in order for you to reassign and allocate your keys for your controller.
For more details on how to do this, please check out our Website (In English) below 
and click on to "STEAM(EN)"

https://www.relayer.jp/other/update.php

Thank you again for your patience and support for Relayer Advanced!
And Happy Holidays 2022

DRAGAMI GAMES
